title: Baniye Majlise aza zainab
body:
BANIYE MAJLISE AZA ZAINAB..
<<DIVIDER>>
SANIYE MAJLISE AZA ZAINAB, WARISE SABRE FATIMA ZAINAB.
Tujhko zalim ne belcha mara, Sar huwa haye tera do para, Jism ka khoon behgaya sara, Yun ghamo se hui reha Zainab.
<<MINI>>
Baniye majlise aza Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindagi bhar mili na koi khushi, Dil pe chalti rahi ghamou ki churi, Phir bhatije ke saath qaid huwi, Gham ka toota na silsila Zainab.
<<MINI>>
Baniye majlise aza Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sham me phir huwi nayi uftaad, Kis tarah seh sakenge yeh bedad, Besahara hai Sayyade Sajjad, Chal basi haye bawafa Zainab.
<<MINI>>
Baniye majlise aza Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar khule izdehaam me jana, Balwaye qaaso aam me jana, Tera darbare shaam me jana, Tha qayamat ka marhala Zainab.
<<MINI>>
Baniye majlise aza Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bekasi me huwi jafa tujhpar, Thi mazalim ki inteha tujhpar, Saare kunbe ka bojh tha tujhpar, Har qadam par thi Karbala Zainab.
<<MINI>>
Baniye majlise aza Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chain tu ne kabhi nahi paya, Zakhm par zakhm tune hai khaya, Sar pe har dam ghamo'n ka tha saya, Tujhpe hoti rahi jafa Zainab.
<<MINI>>
Baniye majlise aza Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
Samna tha tujhe qayamat ka, Ek pal bhi mila na rahat ka, Dardo gham ka har ek musibat ka, Hogaya tujhpe qatema Zainab.
<<MINI>>
Baniye majlise aza Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere majaye ki azadari, Bangayi hai shaoore bedari, Dono aalam me ab bhi hai jari, Tere matam ka silsila Zainab.
<<MINI>>
Baniye majlise aza Zainab.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha 'Hasan' isko farz ka ahsas, Hone paya na use qoufo hiraas, Baade Ashoor ban gayi Abbas, Besaharo'n ka aasra Zainab.
<<MINI>>
Baniye majlise aza Zainab...
